titles: La Tahzan Motivasi Untuk Ibu Hamil
Keganasan Menurut Perspektif Agama Yahudi, Kristian & Islam
partial: Muhammad: Seakan-akan Kamu Melihat & Bertemu Baginda
notes: Landscape, slightly from the left, three shelves of a Malaysian religious bookshop under flat shop light; shrink-wrapped spines with mild reflections, the top shelf cut by the frame so the tops of the left-hand spines are clipped, and the bottom right quarter is motion-blurred. Malay throughout, with Jawi script on the Abdul Hadi Awang shelf and Arabic 'Islam' on the Sejarah Umat Islam covers. Shelf tags name the authors ('Aidh Abdullah al-Qarni, Hamka, Abdul Hadi Awang). Many titles are stocked in multiples; each is labelled once. Titles as printed: the Van der Wijck spines read 'Tenggelamnya Kapal' small and 'Van Der Wijck' large; the Bid'ah dan Khurafat spine carries 'Membersihkan Diri dan Masyarakat daripada' as a lead-in; 'Mazhab Syafi'i, Mazhab Apa?' sits under the 'Amal Kita Akidah Kita' series heading; the Fiqh Al-Harakah volumes are labelled by number. Partial: the top-shelf spines whose first word is clipped by the frame (Bersama Hidangan Al-Quran, Keluarga Bahagia & Sejahtera, Muhammad Seakan-akan..., Panduan Mencari Rezeki Halal, Pilihlah Para Musuhmu) and Menjawab Tuduhan Paderi Kristian at the bottom left, cut by the frame. Left out: the Jawi-script books on the middle shelf (purple and blue covers, plus thin yellow and green spines), the beige Hamka paperbacks right of Membahas Kemusykilan Agama and the thin purple spines beside Lembaga Budi (text too small), the 'Krisis Akidah...' blue spines (title runs past what is readable), a small 'Anak Zina' spine and the leftmost bottom books (cut off), and the motion-blurred books at the bottom right (Rawatan..., Tarikat Al-Tijaniyah, Tasawuf..., Kedudukan Pendidikan...) where the words cannot be read with confidence. Non-book items: loose papers and stationery on the right. Drafted by claude-sonnet-5 (extraction 100), verified by an agent.
